anomalies.observed: The LDO REG2 output is connected to net +3.3V, while the MCU/IO decoupling net +3V3 has no regulator source. FCC1 VDD pins and NAVC1 VDD pins are only present in unconnected nets.
anomalies.expected: The 3.3 V LDO should feed both MCUs; the specification states that 3V3 feeds both MCUs and all I2C sensor ICs.
